title: Mamdani Dismisses Business Leaders Advising NYC Mayor’s Fund
title_cn: 马姆达尼解雇了为纽约市市长基金提供建议的商界领袖
summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani dismissed the business and civic leaders who advised a multimillion-dollar fund that channels private donations into public programs, removing a longstanding group of corporate advisers from City Hall’s philanthropic arm.

title: US Sends Election Monitors to Four Michigan Cities for Primary
title_cn: 美国向密歇根州四个城市派遣选举监测员进行初选
summary: The US Justice Department sent election monitors to four Michigan cities on Tuesday as the state holds a closely watched primary that will set the November lineup for an open US Senate seat — one of the most competitive contests of the 2026 midterms.

title: Talarico Has Narrow Poll Edge on Paxton in Texas Senate Race
title_cn: 塔拉里科在德克萨斯州参议员竞选中对帕克斯顿的民调优势微弱
summary: Democrat James Talarico holds a narrow lead over Republican rival Ken Paxton in the US Senate race in Texas, according to a new poll, bolstering his party’s quest to pick off a pivotal seat amid voter dissatisfaction with President Donald Trump.

title: Cantor on Digital Infrastructure, Fed, Inflation, Energy
title_cn: 坎托谈数字基础设施、美联储、通胀、能源
summary:
Eric Cantor, Moelis & Co. vice chair and former House Majority Leader, talks about what he says is an unprecedented investment cycle driven by a surge in digital infrastructure. He says earnings have been "stunning." Cantor also talks about the performance of Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh. Cantor speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance."
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Japan Defense Report Cites China, Russia, NK Military Ties
title_cn: 日本防务报告援引中国、俄罗斯和朝鲜的军事关系
summary: Growing military coordination between China, Russia and North Korea is heightening security risks for Japan, Tokyo said in its latest defense white paper, citing increasingly provocative Chinese-Russian bomber patrols and Moscow’s support for North Korea’s military modernization.
